summary: Built-in offline GTCRN noise reduction for brrBoard dictation, automatic clean-microphone bypass and BR Brain voice diagnostics.

changes.title: Built-in GTCRN microphone noise reduction
changes.detail: Every new APK carries the ~535 KB MIT-licensed GTCRN model. The keyboard applies noise reduction to measurably noisy speech before the existing private Parakeet recognizer, with no download or audio upload.

changes.title: Protect clear recordings and your speech
changes.detail: A conservative offline noise gate leaves clean microphone and earbud audio untouched. Unexpected model errors or invalid enhanced samples fall back to original audio without aborting dictation; microphone capture remains in the app.

changes.title: BR Brain explains the voice filter
changes.detail: See real on-device counts of enhanced speech windows, clean bypasses and raw fallbacks, plus the latest measured filter processing time; no transcript or audio is kept in diagnostics.

changes.title: APK model integrity and attribution
changes.detail: Both debug and original-signed release builds verify the bundled GTCRN weight bytes against a pinned upstream Git blob and include the MIT notice. Parakeet packaging rejects all other unapproved ONNX files; the optional Parakeet model and signing identity are unchanged.
